name: Voidlark Shadowfeather
description: A matte feather that swallows stray light around its edge.
specialEffects: Used in covert daggers, voidbind fletching, and shadow-pinned gear.

steps: Refine raw stock for Voidlark Shadowfeather under controlled heat and pressure.
Fold and stabilize the blend until impurities are below forge tolerance.
Cast and cool using Voidlark Refinery protocol before storage.
